title: AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability receives a rating from 0 to 3 and a separate evidence level; these are combined into a credit, aggregated into a severity-weighted score and converted into stripes that the gates limit. Instruments gather evidence, language-model judges interpret it under explicit criteria, and the arithmetic is deterministic. translated_title: AgentStripes：一种基于证据分级的AI智能体成熟度模型
translated_abstract: 基准测试只能报告AI智能体在任务套件上能做什么，但无法表明某个发布版本是否经过工程化设计、具备了使其可靠、安全且可观测的控制措施，也无法表明这些特性能被证明到何种程度。本文提出了AgentStripes，一种面向AI智能体的证据分级成熟度模型。该模型定义了等级（0到7条纹）、过程域（12个领域，包含40项能力）、三道关卡（基础、安全、证明）——无论得分多高，关卡都会将智能体限制在某一等级——以及E0到E5的证据等级。每项适用的能力获得0到3的评分以及独立的证据等级；两者合并为学分，再汇总为按严重性加权的分数，并转换为受关卡限制的条纹数。工具负责收集证据，语言模型评审员在明确的标准下对证据进行解读，且整个计算过程是确定性的。该模型在主题层面与相关标准进行了对比，但不做符合性声明，并且……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AgentStripes，一种针对AI智能体的证据分级成熟度模型，通过0-7条纹等级、12个过程域共40项能力、三道关卡和E0-E5证据等级来系统评估智能体的可靠性、安全性与可观测性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents that systematically assesses reliability, safety, and observability through 0-7 stripe levels, 12 process areas with 40 capabilities, three gates, and E0-E5 evidence grades.
